title: Bathroom space saver
text: Bathroom space saver. This cabinet is VERY SHALLOW in depth.  Due to the extremely shallow depth the cabinet is very unstable even on our flat bathroom floor. The screws that afix the doors to the cabinet are barely 1/2 inch and I'm concerned that when some one uses the toilet one of the doors will open making the cabinet that much more unstable.  This was supposed to go in my teenage daughter bathroom for her toiletries and hair items, I'm afraid with too much more weight all on the top, the think will fall on her so we have it in our guest bathroom for the time being as it is seldom used, It will occupy the garage as soon as I can find a suitable replacement for it and will be used to store only light weight out of season items after securing it to the back wall of the garage.  The back support brace of the cabinet was positioned too low to the floor to provide any additional stability and interfered with our plumbing inlet hose to the toilet.  All in all, a waste of my money and a good hour and 1/2 putting it together.  Next time I'll be purchasing a deeper cabinet with more stability from a different seller - NOT Elegant Home Fashions.
